entities.summary: Giljegiljaw Kungkuan, also known as Giljaw or Giyaw, previously known as Chu Li-Jen, is a Taiwanese professional baseball catcher for the Wei Chuan Dragons of the Chinese Professional Baseball League (CPBL). Giljegiljaw signed with the Cleveland Guardians as a free agent in 2012, and stayed with the organization until 2020 when he left to play for the Dragons.
